verdict.rationale: Render documents a full REST API with OpenAPI spec, a CLI, and an MCP server that exposes actions like triggering deploys and managing services/datastores, indicating broad API-level control mirroring UI capabilities. However, there is no explicit vendor claim or independent verification of 100% feature parity between UI and API/CLI, so some UI-only edge cases may remain unconfirmed. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement covering every UI feature, and independent/hands-on confirmation that no UI-only actions exist.
